notes: PRD §60 lane-comparison scenarios. answer_any: any substring (case-insensitive) in wiki matches[].value/subject or baseline top-3 text. answer_all: every substring must appear. forbid: substring must not appear in the wiki top match's value (top = highest score) or in baseline top file. subject: at least one match on that claim subject. conflict_expected: wiki conflicts non-empty; baseline = all answer_all/answer_any strings visible across top-3 files. expect_gap: wiki gaps non-empty and no matches; baseline never detects gaps.
